name: List Matcher
tagline: Free in-browser tool to compare two lists and see what is only in one list or in both.
description: List Matcher (listmatcher.com) is a free online tool to compare two lists in your browser. Paste or drop spreadsheet files, see what’s only in one list or in both, and copy or download a result you can keep working with. The comparison runs locally; list contents aren’t sent to a server.
